findings: Ordinary optimize explicitly enables the hole-rider pre-pass; common-line bonus optimization explicitly disables it.
The common-line search receives90% of its budget, then the translation bonus uses the remaining budget.
The translation bonus material ceiling is1.01 times its own independently valid starting layout, not the external equal-spacing ordinary benchmark.
An ordinary hole-rider layout cannot be used as a valid common-line fallback while retaining the required part-in-hole-off geometry.

This review identifies no safe production shortcut that closes the external H5 material gate. Changing the ordinary comparison or enabling riders in common-line mode would not satisfy the existing requirement.
